name: ECC database-migrations
author: affaan-m

amendments.append: Migrations are safe on a live database: renames and drops go expand → migrate → contract across releases; indexes on existing tables are built `CONCURRENTLY`; a `lock_timeout` is set; a new `NOT NULL` column has a default; schema (DDL) and data backfills are separate migrations; a migration that has run anywhere shared is never edited — a new one corrects it. *Enforced by:* `squawk` (Postgres) or `atlas migrate lint` in CI.

notes: The repo ships a large hook set (session, shell, file, MCP and subagent events) — only this one skill file was read; nothing installed.
rationale: Chosen for COR-7 over wshobson's sql-migrations because it states the live-database checklist compactly (expand–contract, CONCURRENTLY, NOT NULL defaults, DDL/backfill split, immutable applied migrations). Only this skill was read; the ECC bundle and its large hook set are not installed.
